abilities.name: Proving Dough
abilities.description: Knead a loaf and it rises in an hour instead of a night, if you hum while it bakes.
abilities.cost: Needs flour, salt and an hour at the oven

growth.grows: how many loaves and how good they taste

abilities.name: Seedling Coaxing
abilities.description: Speak softly to a wilting plant and it perks up for a day, long enough to be sold or saved.
abilities.cost: Your own energy dips; you crave sweets

growth.grows: how sick a plant and how long it lasts

abilities.name: Neighbor's Name
abilities.description: When you meet someone in the village, you can recall the name of someone they love and one thing that worries them.
abilities.cost: Works only on people you have shared a meal with

growth.grows: how much of their worries you remember

abilities.name: Mending Hands
abilities.description: Hold a torn coat or cracked bowl in both hands for a minute to mend it neatly.
abilities.cost: One mend at a time; leaves you sleepy

growth.grows: how badly broken a thing you can mend

abilities.name: Hen Whisperer
abilities.description: Call loose farm animals and they come back to their pen within a few minutes.
abilities.cost: Only animals that know your voice

growth.grows: how many animals and how wild

abilities.name: Market Morning
abilities.description: When you set up a stall, the first three customers always stop to look, even on a slow day.
abilities.cost: The stall must be tidy and the goods honest

abilities.name: Lantern Path
abilities.description: Light a paper lantern and anyone walking home in the dark can follow its glow safely until it gutters.
abilities.cost: The lantern burns out after one trip

growth.grows: how far the path and how many walkers

abilities.name: Comfort Stew
abilities.description: Brew a stew in your pot and whoever eats it sleeps soundly and wakes free of a bad mood.
abilities.cost: Takes an afternoon and fresh vegetables

growth.grows: how heavy a sorrow it lifts and how many it feeds

abilities.name: Rumor Garden
abilities.description: Mention something at the well and you can hear it come back to you from three other people by evening.
abilities.cost: Rumors bend; what comes back is never quite what you said

abilities.name: Harvest Ache
abilities.description: Sense from an ache in your knee whether tomorrow will be dry enough for the harvest.
abilities.cost: The ache is real and slows you on wet days

growth.grows: how many days ahead it tells

abilities.name: Lost Thing Finder
abilities.description: Ask out loud for a lost small thing and you can sense which room of the house it is in.
abilities.cost: Only things that were loved by someone

growth.grows: how far away and how small the thing

abilities.name: Festival Spirit
abilities.description: Start a song at a gathering and the crowd joins in, easing any quarrel there until the song ends.

growth.grows: how bitter a quarrel it can ease
